entries.classification: Historical competition recap; not an invitation and never an open-registration alert.
entries.competition_evidence: Article describes a cybersecurity/networking Capture-the-Flag competition, preparation activities, ranked winners, and an award ceremony.
entries.completion_quote: On October 26, the event closed with the Awarding Ceremony
entries.scope: The event was held with the linked Huawei Cloud Developer Group Philippines; this relationship provides Philippine connection independent of the news publisher.
entries.source_roles: The first five linked organizations are contributors under a made-possible-by clause, not explicitly hosts. Two links are explicitly Challenge Partners. The named Philippines group is a held-with contributor. Appkademiya is explicitly a sponsor but has no public link in this article.
entries.original_facebook_note: The feed/article links public organization accounts and a group, not an original competition post.
entries.existing_adapter_miss: Publisher-context scope gate cannot recognize the held-with relationship; clean feed title omits CTF and lacks a labeled event date. Article metadata title contains CTF, but baseline still rejects scope. Sidebar/footer content must not establish identity.
entries.usefulness: Historical corroboration and publisher candidates. No timely registration discovery.

limits: Leads are candidates until recurring public sources are verified. Public Facebook account URLs do not prove backend-readability.
Names without public URLs stay evidence-scoped; no display-name-only global organization merge.
Relationship roles do not establish open registration.
No Luma permalink or original Facebook competition post was linked in these feed articles.
Philippine sponsorship or generic contributor status alone does not establish event scope; require a named linked host/organizer or explicit held-with organization.
